description:
Use for questions about how Moda works: joining a group, approval times, membership, posting rules, declined posts, bans, the middleman, payments, refunds, reporting a problem or contacting the team.
question: the person's question in their own words.
Returns JSON with up to three of Moda's published help answers, word for word, each with its link, in Moda's published wording.
name: search_moda_help
title: Search Moda's help answers
